ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.
   C. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
   D. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.
   C. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   C. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
   B. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting
